posts.content_md:
I mentioned in a different post that my last batch of plate was bad. Or so I thougth because I modifed the forumula and got blotches in the center on every single plate from that batch. Well I made another batch two nights ago with known formulations and was shooting last night and noticed the same thing. I decided it may not be the emulsion but the alcohols. I changed each of the baths and the problem cleared up. I think one of the batchs became comtaminated. I am very carful but clean and strip my plates in the sink next to the alcohol baths. Some HCl acid or something else may have splashed onto on of the lids of one of the baths and when I take the lids off to process much have contaminated the bath. 

I moved my cleaning/stipping station to the bathroom.

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
This bears on a subject that Andres and I talk about somewhat regularly. 

What environments do the rest of the forum work in when processing their holograms?

I've pretty much got a room (my office) dedicated to the shooting and partial processing of my holograms but have to take them out to an outside bathroom for final sqeegeeing, drying and backing. I keep a hepa fan running most of the time in my office and keep the bathroom as clean (although not "neat" as wifey will surely attest) as possible.

One nice thing about using the JD2 formula is that if you splash any on the counter when mixing or pouring the stock solution, you'll have black dots on your counter the next day. A sure sign that you need to be more careful. (I've got one of those staring at me now)
